## Page 1
FleetOps: An End-to-End System for Warehouse Robot Deployment
Frank Builder, Gina Ops
Robotics Institute, Example University
Abstract
We present FleetOps, an end-to-end system and open-source platform for deploying robot fleets in warehouses. The system integrates
perception, planning and scheduling services behind a common API. We describe the deployment pipeline, the monitoring dashboard
and lessons learned from a six-month pilot.
